css: .t6-shell{font:13px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif;color:#172033;background:#f7f8fb;border:1px solid #dfe3ea;border-radius:16px;padding:15px;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;max-width:100%;overflow:hidden}.t6-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px}.t6-head p{margin:0;color:#6c7688;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.09em;font-size:10px}.t6-head h2{margin:2px 0 0;font-size:20px}.t6-counts{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}.t6-counts span{border:1px solid #d8dee8;background:white;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 8px;font-size:11px}.t6-toolbar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px}.t6-toolbar>div{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}.t6-shell button{appearance:none;border:1px solid #cbd3df;background:white;border-radius:7px;padding:7px 9px;font:inherit;font-weight:650;color:#253047;cursor:pointer}.t6-move button{background:#edf2fb;color:#294aa7;border-color:#cfd9f1}.t6-move span{font-size:11px;color:#657084;margin-right:3px}.t6-list{display:grid;gap:6px}.t6-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto auto;gap:9px;align-items:center;background:white;border:1px solid #dde2ea;border-radius:9px;padding:8px 10px;min-width:0}.t6-row.is-selected{border-color:#7f96dd;background:#f5f7ff}.t6-row input{width:16px;height:16px}.t6-row strong{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.t6-row .t6-owner{color:#667186;font-size:11px}.t6-status{border-radius:999px;padding:3px 8px;background:#eef1f5;font-size:11px}.t6-status[data-status="Doing"]{background:#fff3d6;color:#805700}.t6-status[data-status="Done"]{background:#e7f7ee;color:#176b3a}@media(max-width:650px){.t6-row{grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto}.t6-owner{display:none}.t6-head{display:block}.t6-counts{justify-content:flex-start;margin-top:8px}}
js: const list=root.querySelector('[data-list]');const selectedCount=root.querySelector('[data-selected-count]');const countEls={Todo:root.querySelector('[data-c=Todo]'),Doing:root.querySelector('[data-c=Doing]'),Done:root.querySelector('[data-c=Done]')};function tasks(){return api.getState('tasks')||[];}function selected(){const ids=api.getState('selectedTaskIds');return Array.isArray(ids)?ids:[];}function setSelected(ids){api.setState('selectedTaskIds',[...new Set(ids)]);}function render(){const all=tasks();const sel=new Set(selected());['Todo','Doing','Done'].forEach(s=>countEls[s].textContent=String(all.filter(t=>t.status===s).length));selectedCount.textContent=sel.size+' selected';list.replaceChildren(...all.map(t=>{const row=document.createElement('label');row.className='t6-row'+(sel.has(t.id)?' is-selected':'');const box=document.createElement('input');box.type='checkbox';box.checked=sel.has(t.id);box.addEventListener('change',()=>{const next=new Set(selected());if(box.checked)next.add(t.id);else next.delete(t.id);setSelected([...next]);});const title=document.createElement('strong');title.textContent=t.title||'(untitled)';const owner=document.createElement('span');owner.className='t6-owner';owner.textContent=t.owner||'Unassigned';const status=document.createElement('span');status.className='t6-status';status.dataset.status=t.status||'';status.textContent=t.status||'—';row.append(box,title,owner,status);return row;}));}root.querySelector('[data-select-all]').addEventListener('click',()=>setSelected(tasks().map(t=>t.id)));root.querySelector('[data-clear]').addEventListener('click',()=>setSelected([]));root.querySelectorAll('[data-move]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{const ids=new Set(selected());if(!ids.size){api.log(6,'No tasks selected');return;}const next=tasks().map(t=>ids.has(t.id)?{...t,status:btn.dataset.move}:t);api.setState('tasks',next);api.log(6,'Moved '+ids.size+' task(s) to '+btn.dataset.move);}));render();const unsubscribe=api.subscribe(render);root.addEventListener('bci:unmount',unsubscribe,{once:true});
